remarks: PLEASE SUBMIT ALL OFFERS BY MONDAY 4/28 4PM. Discover the ease of living at 15 Lone Pine Lane, a home located in one of Westport's most coveted in-town neighborhoods. This property's central location ensures convenience, while the quiet streets provide a peaceful retreat. The interior has been refreshed over the years showcasing noticeable upgrades like a modern kitchen, updated bathrooms and lighting. Hidden upgrades include the recent connection to sewer, a new roof in Dec 2019 and new wood flooring which further enhance this move-in-ready home. The interior is light & cheerful and was recently painted neutral finishes that create a welcoming ambiance. The eat-in kitchen seamlessly flows into the family room and playroom (which could also be a DR), perfect for gatherings and entertainment. Outside, enjoy a private, fenced-in level yard featuring a bluestone patio and a handcrafted stone wall, ideal for outdoor relaxation and entertainment. The property includes an oversized two-car garage with expansion potential above, adding to its versatile appeal. This home is meticulously maintained and recently painted inside & out. Enjoy the vibrant community life with a short walk to local coffee shops, a scenic stroll along the Saugatuck River to the library or a free concert at Levitt Pavilion. Nearby, discover a variety of shops and restaurants, the Westport Country Playhouse and fresh produce at the Farmers Market, all within walking distance from your new home on Lone Pine Lan
